normal: Brightness and contrast are within the normal range.
caption: Brightness of the gray fields in the image (0% black, 100% white)

tooDark.label: Brightness too low
tooDark.hint: Increase the brightness (add light or raise the camera exposure). Then check the contrast.

tooBright.label: Brightness too high
tooBright.hint: Reduce the brightness (dim the light or lower the camera exposure). Then check the contrast.

lowContrast.label: Contrast too low
lowContrast.hint: Brightness is fine. Increase the contrast (raise the camera contrast).

highContrast.label: Contrast too high
highContrast.hint: Brightness is fine. Reduce the contrast (lower the camera contrast or use softer light).

issue.bothClipped: Shadows underexposed and highlights overexposed: reduce the contrast, align the light more evenly and avoid reflections on the card.
issue.shadowsCrushed: Shadows underexposed: first increase the brightness (add light or raise the camera exposure) until the darkest stripe field is no longer black. Then check the contrast.
issue.highlightsBright: Highlights overexposed: reduce the brightness (dim the light or lower the camera exposure). Then check the contrast.
issue.highlightsContrast: Highlights overexposed: reduce the contrast (lower the camera contrast or use softer light).
